description: Screen, keyboard and file sharing of the Cardputer Zero from the phone browser

store.summary: Use the Cardputer from your phone: live screen, keys and files, over Tailscale
store.description:
Use the Cardputer Zero from your phone: see its screen live in the browser, type on it and share files, through your own Tailscale network.

- Remote screen: the 320x170 screen, sharp and live (only the rows that change are sent, up to 20 fps), with buttons for Esc, Tab, Enter, arrows, delete and space, your phone's keyboard for typing, and the battery level.
- Touch the picture: it wakes the screen and unlocks the launcher; on the launcher, the sides move between apps and the centre opens one. Inside apps a touch sends nothing.
- File sharing: Music, Pictures, Videos, Downloads, Documents and GPS tracks. Upload from the phone (never overwrites), download, create folders and delete. Nothing outside those folders.
- The Remote app shows two switches (remote screen, file sharing; file sharing starts off) and a QR code with the address: scan it with the phone camera. The same switches are on the web page.

It only listens on the device's Tailscale address and refuses anything outside Tailscale, so nobody on the same Wi-Fi can see it. While nobody is connected it does nothing. Needs Tailscale on the Cardputer and on the phone. The service runs as the device user (not root), in Python with only the standard library.
